Our Heritage

Elevating Tea Culture in Bengaluru

Founded in 2016 by Aarav Sharma, Test Tea House began with a simple vision: to bring handpicked Himalayan whole-leaf teas and rich traditional chai into a contemporary, soul-fulfilling experience.

"We view tea not just as a beverage, but as a daily ritual of mindfulness, warmth, and genuine human connection."

The Test Tea Difference

Why Tea Lovers Choose Us

We take pride in bringing back purity, patience, and passion into every cup we brew.

100% Whole Loose Leaf

We strictly source direct single-origin estate leaves without artificial aromas, ensuring authentic natural flavor notes.

Precision Temp Control

Every tea variety is steeped at custom water temperatures and precise timings to unlock smooth, non-bitter profiles.

Cozy Vibrant Ambience

Designed for deep conversations, work, or solitary reflection paired with welcoming hospitality in the heart of Bengaluru.

Crafted With Precision

Our 3-Step Artisan Process

Discover how Head Brewer Aarav Sharma and our team ensure absolute perfection in every cup.

01

Ethical Leaf Selection

Hand-plucked leaves harvested from high-altitude Himalayan tea gardens, checked for essential oil content.

02

Custom Water & Infusion

Filtered spring-quality water heated to calibrated temperatures to draw out nuanced undertones without bitterness.

03

Artisan Kulhad Serving

Poured fresh into earthen clay pots or glass steepers, paired with chef-crafted savories for pure bliss.

Ready for Your Perfect Brew?

Visit us at Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru or drop by during our opening hours to experience pure tea mastery.
